name: SVR Poker Android
nextApkDrop: Only after the Android web game passes a stable playtest batch.
notes: Do not force testers to update the APK every phase.
Use the stable Android web route for ongoing game logic and UX updates.
Phase 336 preserves Phase 332 chip physics, Phase 333 shaders and controls, Phase 334 table and gesture layout, and Phase 335 Oculus stability.
Phase 336 replaces the temporary poker core with one authoritative engine for player stacks, round bets, physical chips, pot totals, legal actions, burns, cards, and payouts.

Phase 336 adds variable raises, minimum-raise enforcement, short all-in handling, main and side pots, split-pot settlement, tied winners, correct action order, and no automatic rebuy for busted players.
Phase 336 stores an interrupted-hand snapshot for short browser or headset interruptions and exposes exact physical-bet and raise-to bridges.
Quest/Oculus gameplay remains on the WebXR route; Android keeps its stable touch-first route.
Director preview remains separate and must contain no Android controls or visible runtime overlays.
Build a new native APK only when native app code, package, permissions, signing, icon, WebView shell, or release channel changes.
